original_clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Access to a shared internal service for one authorised purpose does not confer authority to create a new communication topology across otherwise separate execution scopes.

original_clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: A missing task dependency may justify bounded search, escalation or non-completion, but it does not by itself enlarge authority to establish an otherwise unavailable collaboration channel.
